title: KubeCon EU 2026 - expense reminders + vendor contacts (scratchpad)
content:
Quick scratchpad for final expense reminders, vendor contacts, and things to tidy up after KubeCon EU 2026. Mostly notes to self and action items for Jordan/Alex/Olivia.

Status snapshot:
- All booth invoices received except AV final invoice (expecting by 2026-02-10).
- Hotel group block confirmed at Hilton Amsterdam (reservation #HLT-99871). Corporate rate applied to names on the spreadsheet.
- Shuttle invoice (GroundConnect) pending — they asked for PO number from finance.

Expense reminders (for Redwood attendees):
- Submit all Ramp expenses within 30 days of date of expense (deadline: 2026-03-09).
- Must attach itemized receipt for any charge > $25. Card statements alone are NOT sufficient.
- For meals: include attendee list and client/employee designation. Alcohol is only reimbursable if with a customer and pre-approved.
- Per diem guideline: follow internal policy (see Confluence link above).
- When in doubt, tag expenses with project code: KUBE2026 (use Ramp form link).

TODO (priority order):
- [ ] Follow up with AV vendor for final invoice and detailed line items (contact below) — assigned to Jordan — due 2026-02-10.
- [ ] Confirm shuttle PO with Finance (Olivia) — ask for PO number and forward to GroundConnect.
- [ ] Consolidate vendor receipts into a single zip and upload to Ramp (me) — aim 2026-02-12.
- [ ] Remind team to forward any out-of-pocket receipts (Uber, taxis, tips) with date/time and attendee name.

Vendor contacts (copy into email thread):
- AV: ProAudioNL / contact: Marco van Dijk <marco@proaudionl.com> / +31 20 123 4567 / Booth AV + on-site tech support / Invoice to be sent to accounting@redwood.ai (asked to include breakdown: labor, eq rental, patching).
- Drayage & Freight: VanHees Logistics / contact: Inge Brouwer <inge@vanheeslogistics.nl> / +31 10 555 7890 / Fed-weight handling + storage fees. Bill to Redwood Inference, Attn: Events.
- Catering (reception): TasteWorks / contact: Leila Karim <leila@tasteworks.eu> / +31 20 998 3344 / We ordered vegetarian + 10% gluten-free options. Invoice to be split 70/30 between marketing/events.
- Hotel (group): Hilton Amsterdam / group reservations: HLT-99871 / events@hiltonamsterdam.com / Guest billing: individuals use corporate card or get itemized receipt for reimbursement.
- Shuttle: GroundConnect / contact: Pieter van den Berg <pieter@groundconnect.nl> / +31 30 777 2233 / Asked for PO reference; waiting.

Payment notes + accounting asks:
- For vendor invoices: request invoices to include VAT breakdown and company VAT number for reclaim.
- If vendor asks for payment method, prefer bank transfer (SEPA) to avoid card fees. Use AP mailbox: ap@redwood.ai and cc events@redwood.ai.
- For any invoices > €5k, need AP approval code (Finance: Martin O.). Email Martin with subject: "KubeCon EU invoice approval - <vendor>".

Receipts & filing tips (for teammates):
- Take a clear photo of paper receipts immediately with date/time and vendor name visible.
- Uber receipts: forward receipt email to receipts@ramp.com with KUBE2026 in subject.
- Taxi cash: include short note with date/time and who rode.

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Confirm whether catering gratuity included in TasteWorks invoice or billed separately (Leila to confirm).
- AV asked if fabric backdrop is company-owned or rental — need to confirm whether to add to drayage manifest.
- Do we want to reimburse local team per diem differently? Check with People Ops (Ping: @Maya).

Quick timeline: 
- 2026-02-10: AV final invoice expected / Jordan to chase if not received by noon.
- 2026-02-12: Upload consolidated receipts to Ramp / Samantha (me).
- 2026-02-15: Finalize expense report and submit for approvals (so Finance can close month).

Notes to self (messy):
- Booth carpet stain — ask VanHees about cleaning charge estimate before approving final invoice.
- Someone grabbed a hotel minibar charge on corporate card (check line item, request refund if personal).
- Reminder: submit mileage claim for car drop-off to storage facility (small reimbursement).

Reference links (copy-paste into email):
- Confluence ops page: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/EVENTS/KubeCon+EU+2026+Ops
- Booth drayage form (VanHees): https://vanheeslogistics.nl/forms/kubecon-eu-2026-drayage.pdf
- Ramp expense form: https://ramp.com/company/redwood/expenses/form/KUBE2026

If anyone reading this (Jordan/Alex/Olivia): ping me on Slack @samantha (or reply-all) with any missing receipts. I'll do a final pass on 2026-02-12 and then close the file.

-- Samantha
